descriptionChirho: The proper name Korah (קֹרַח), referring to several OT figures: most prominently the Levite who led a rebellion against Moses (Nu 16:1,5,6,16,19,24,27,32,40,49; 26:9-11; 27:3), also an Edomite clan chief (Gen 36:5,14,16,18; 1Chr 1:35), and the eponymous ancestor of the 'sons of Korah' psalm superscriptions (Ps 42:1; 44:1; 45:1; 46:1; 47:1; 48:1; 49:1; 84:1; 85:1; 87:1; 88:1; 1Chr 6:7,22; 9:19,31; 26:1,19). All three clusters are identical in reference with only grammatical variation: bare name, with preposition kaph ('like Korah'), and with conjunction waw ('and Korah'). Spanish 'Coré/Qoraj,' Arabic 'قُورَحَ/قورَح,' Korean '고라,' Swahili 'Kora,' and Hindi 'कोरह' are uniform.
